description: This file defines a React component 'CopyToClip' that provides a copy-to-clipboard functionality with optional tooltip and styling, and exports it as 'CopyToClipboard'. It includes default properties, event handling, and integration with toast notifications.

classes.name: CopyToClip
classes.description: React component class implementing copy-to-clipboard with tooltip and toast notifications.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click event to trigger copying text to clipboard.

methods.name: getDecoratedCopyNode
methods.description: Returns a clone of the copyNode element with added styles and click handler.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Performs the copy operation and shows success or error toast.

methods.name: renderTooltip
methods.description: Renders the copy node with optional tooltip.

methods.name: renderNotWrapped
methods.description: Renders the copy node without wrapping in a link.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders the copy node as a link with optional text and tooltip.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method deciding between wrapped or not wrapped display.
